title: Boss
author: Louis N.
desc: Unlock your potential with the Boss program, a dynamic 1-week challenge designed to sculpt your core and enhance your strength. With five training days packed into 90-minute sessions, you'll engage in a variety of bodyweight and weighted exercises, including Planks, Dead Bugs, and Cable Crunches, tailored for intermediate lifters. This program focuses on building athleticism and muscle while pushing your limits in a full gym environment. Get ready to elevate your fitness game and feel empowered every step of the way!
